question:
How many glass are both phone and pen?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fcc807050d438e00d54524e78f34c3e89dda62f60bf319ffcfe6eb68a07a8bd.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f0ae3502bfb55544646fa92595328832890e9acd938cb50d3a015f8b58aa50d.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of glass are both phone and pen".

So, the total number of 'glass are both phone and pen' = 11.

Hence, the correct answer is "11".
